APP.TITLE: Local Leads
APP.SUBTITLE: Find local businesses by locality and spot the ones missing contact data.
NAV.LABEL: Main navigation
HOME.LEAD: Search any locality, list its local businesses with their phone, email, website and address, and instantly spot the ones that still need an online presence.
HOME.ZOOM_TEXT: From the whole planet to the streets of {{place}}: type a place, pick a radius and the app maps every shop, restaurant and office around it.
HOME.ZOOM_TEXT_NEARBY: From the whole planet to the streets around you: type a place, pick a radius and the app maps every shop, restaurant and office around it.
HOME.LEADS_TITLE: Spot who is missing contact data
HOME.LEADS_TEXT: Each business comes with the data you would copy from Google Maps. Filter the ones without a mobile, email or website — they are your best leads.
HOME.HOW_TITLE: From a place name to a list of qualified leads in three steps
HOME.STEP_1_TEXT: Type a town or city, choose the radius and the kinds of businesses you want to reach.
HOME.STEP_2_TEXT: Keep the businesses without a phone, mobile, email or website — the ones that need your services.
HOME.STEP_3_TEXT: Pick the leads and send personalised emails from your own templates — with a test mode to check everything first.
HOME.FEATURES_TITLE: Everything you need to prospect locally
HOME.FEATURE_SOURCES_TEXT: OpenStreetMap out of the box and free; Google Places when you add an API key.
HOME.FEATURE_FILTERS_TEXT: No phone, no mobile, no email, no website or no data at all — combined as you need.
HOME.FEATURE_MOBILE_TEXT: Portuguese mobile numbers are tagged so you know who you can text.
HOME.FEATURE_EXPORT_TEXT: Download the filtered list, ready for Excel, your CRM or a mailing tool.
HOME.FEATURE_I18N_TEXT: Switch the interface language at any time from the top bar.
HOME.FEATURE_EMAIL_TEXT: Send personalised emails to many leads at once, with variables and a safe test mode.
HOME.CTA_TITLE: Ready to find your next client?
HOME.CTA_TEXT: Start with your own town — it takes less than a minute.
SEARCH.LOADING: Looking for businesses, this can take a few seconds…
SEARCH.HINT: Type a locality and press Search to find local businesses.
SEARCH.PAGE_SUBTITLE: Choose a locality, pick the business categories and filter the ones missing a phone, email or website.
FILTERS.TITLE: Filters
FILTERS.NO_CONTACT_DATA_HINT: No phone, no email and no website.
RESULTS.TITLE: Leads
RESULTS.NAME: Name
RESULTS.NO_MATCHES: No businesses match the current filters.
FIELDS.NAME: Business name
EMAIL.TEST_MODE_HINT: Every email will be sent to {{email}} instead of the businesses.
EMAIL.LIVE_MODE_HINT: Emails will be sent to the real businesses.
EMAIL.SMTP_MISSING: The sending account is not configured yet.
EMAIL.UNKNOWN_KEYS: Placeholders without a variable (they will be sent as they are):
EMAIL.SUBJECT: Subject
EMAIL_ERRORS.SERVER_OFFLINE: The email server is not running. Start the app with "npm run dev" (or run "npm run server").
EMAIL_ERRORS.SERVER_ERROR: The email server returned an unexpected error.
EMAIL_ERRORS.SMTP_INCOMPLETE: Configure the SMTP server and port in Settings first.
EMAIL_ERRORS.FROM_INVALID: The sender email in Settings is not valid.
EMAIL_ERRORS.TEST_EMAIL_INVALID: Test mode needs a valid test email (or sender email).
EMAIL_ERRORS.SMTP_FAILED: Could not connect to the SMTP server. Check host, port, user and password.
EMAIL_ERRORS.GMAIL_AUTH_FAILED: Gmail rejected the login. Use an app password (not your normal password): turn on 2-Step Verification, create one at myaccount.google.com/apppasswords, paste it in Settings and use your full Gmail address as username.
EMAIL_ERRORS.AUTH_FAILED: The SMTP server rejected the username or password.
EMAIL_ERRORS.NO_RECIPIENT: This business has no email address.
TEMPLATES.TITLE: Email templates
TEMPLATES.SUBTITLE: Write your outreach emails once. Variables such as {{nome_cliente}} are replaced with each business's data when sending.
TEMPLATES.EMPTY: No templates yet. Create one to get started.
TEMPLATES.NAME: Template name
TEMPLATES.INSERT_VARIABLE: Insert variable (click to add at the cursor)
VARIABLES.TITLE: Template variables
VARIABLES.INTRO: Give each variable a name: "Client Name" becomes {{client_name}}. In the email it is replaced by the field you choose, or by a fixed text.
VARIABLES.LABEL: Name
VARIABLES.ERROR_KEY: Use lowercase letters, numbers and _ (starting with a letter).
VARIABLES.ERROR_DUPLICATE: Another variable already uses this placeholder.
HISTORY.TITLE: Send history
HISTORY.SUBTITLE: Every email sent from the app. Only real (non-test) emails mark a business as contacted in the search results.
HISTORY.SKIP_CONTACTED_HINT: They already received a real email (see History).
HISTORY.CONFIRM_CLEAR_TEST: Remove all test emails from the history?
HISTORY.CONFIRM_CLEAR_ALL: Remove the whole history? Businesses will no longer show as contacted.
HISTORY.NO_MATCHES: No emails match the current filters.
SETTINGS.TITLE: Email settings
SETTINGS.SUBTITLE: The account used to send emails. These details are stored only on your local server (server/data), never in the browser or in git.
SETTINGS.TEST_TEXT: While on, every email goes to your own address so you can check the result before contacting real businesses.
SETTINGS.TEST_EMAIL_HINT: Leave empty to use the sender email.
SETTINGS.LIVE_WARNING: Test mode is off: emails will be sent to the businesses.
SETTINGS.SMTP_TEXT: Server details from your email provider.
SETTINGS.GMAIL_HINT: Gmail requires 2-step verification and an app password (not your normal password):
SETTINGS.PASSWORD_HINT: Leave empty to keep the current one. Write-only: it is never sent back to the browser.
SETTINGS.VERIFY_OK: Connected and authenticated with the SMTP server.
ERRORS.LOCALITY_NOT_FOUND: Locality not found. Try a different name (e.g. "Leiria, Portugal").
ERRORS.GEOCODING_FAILED: Could not locate the locality. Check your connection and try again.
ERRORS.PROVIDER_BUSY: The data source is busy right now. Please try again in a minute.
ERRORS.PROVIDER_TIMEOUT: The search took too long. Try a smaller radius or fewer categories.
ERRORS.PROVIDER_FAILED: The data source returned an error. Try a smaller radius or fewer categories.
ERRORS.GOOGLE_KEY_MISSING: Google Places needs an API key in src/environments/environment.ts.
ERRORS.GENERIC: Something went wrong. Please try again.
